Answer: B
Reason: The imaging demonstrates right lung hypoplasia (specifically involving the upper lobe/arterial supply) with a characteristic scimitar vein, causing volume loss on the right that pulls the mediastinum toward the affected side (dextroposition). Options suggesting left-sided pathology or mass effect are inconsistent with the right-sided findings and the direction of the shift.
